answer: Bindings are kept in ridge, verified in harbor, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the signal check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 136 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
